note: 研究级深度六类的检测规则索引；sigma/falco 为事件语义，kyverno/gatekeeper 为阻断策略语义。规则文本是行为特征，不含可直接复用的利用载荷。

rules.title: vLLM 运维面未认证 200 而 /v1/models 401
rules.match: http.route in (/admin/config,/plugins/list,/dev/exec,/update_weights_from_tensor,/pull_weights) AND http.status=200 AND auth.credentials absent AND control.route=/v1/models AND control.status=401

rules.title: 外部源调用 vLLM 插件路由
rules.match: http.route=/plugins/invoke AND src.ip not in (pod_cidr,node_cidr) AND http.method=POST

rules.title: vLLM worker 从非 rank 源加载 pickle
rules.match: evt.type in (execve,openat,fexecve) AND proc.name=python AND fd.name contains _pickle AND k8s.pod.name contains vllm AND src.ip not in worker_peers

rules.title: 请求携带 mm_processor_kwargs.code_revision 触发动态代码
rules.match: http.route in (/v1/chat/completions,/v1/completions) AND request.body contains code_revision AND vllm.trust_remote_code=true

rules.title: Kyverno 覆盖 pods/exec 与 ephemeralcontainers
Constraint 覆盖 CRD 所有 served version 与 cluster scope
rules.match: constraint.spec.match.kinds[].apiGroups contains example.com AND object.apiVersion not in constraint.spec.match.kinds[].apiVersions

rules.title: execveat/fexecve/memfd 无文件执行
rules.match: evt.type in (execveat,fexecve,memfd_create) OR (evt.type=execve AND proc.exe startswith memfd:)

rules.title: 逃逸后 host namespace 操作
rules.match: evt.type in (setns,unshare,mount,ptrace) AND proc.pidns.host=true AND container.id in (,host)

rules.title: GPU driver/toolkit Pod privileged 或宿主 /dev 挂载
rules.match: k8s.deployment.name contains nvidia-driver AND (pod.securityContext.privileged=true OR volume.hostPath.path startswith /dev)

rules.title: DCGM exporter NodePort 且无鉴权
rules.match: k8s.service.name contains dcgm AND k8s.service.type in (NodePort,LoadBalancer) AND service.auth=false

rules.title: SONiC PFC watchdog 关闭或阈值异常
SHARP 会话建立无作业令牌
rules.match: evt.type=connect AND fd.sport=18515 AND sharp.session.auth=false AND src.ip not in job_ranks

rules.title: OIDC sub/aud/iss 条件缺失或通配
rules.match: cloud.iam.trust.condition has no token.actions.githubusercontent.com:sub OR value contains * OR no token.actions.githubusercontent.com:iss
